title: ConvexLLM: Scaling Convex-Hull Speech Interfaces to General-Purpose Audio Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2610.23539v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speech and audio language models connect continuous acoustic representations to decoders pretrained primarily on text data. Most such models use MLP or Q-Former interfaces to map acoustic features into the decoder's input space, requiring the decoder to learn how to interpret the resulting representations. We investigate whether grounding these representations in the decoder's existing text embeddings can help it use acoustic information while better preserving its pretrained text capabilities. We present ConvexLLM, a general-purpose speech and audio language model whose C-Gate interface represents audio as continuous convex combinations of frozen text embeddings. ConvexLLM achieves an eleven-task VoiceBench aggregate of 75.36, the highest among the open-weight models we compare, and an MMAU Test-mini accuracy of 62.50%. translated_title: ConvexLLM：将凸包语音接口扩展至通用音频智能
translated_abstract: 语音和音频语言模型将连续的声学表示与主要在文本数据上预训练的解码器相连接。大多数此类模型使用MLP或Q-Former接口将声学特征映射到解码器的输入空间，这要求解码器学习如何解释所得到的表示。我们研究了将这些表示锚定在解码器已有的文本嵌入中，是否能够帮助其利用声学信息，同时更好地保留其预训练的文本能力。我们提出了ConvexLLM，一个通用的语音和音频语言模型，其C-Gate接口将音频表示为冻结文本嵌入的连续凸组合。ConvexLLM在VoiceBench的十一项任务上取得了75.36的综合得分，是我们所比较的开源权重模型中最高的，其MMAU Test-mini准确率达到62.50%。它相对于基线模型的最大优势体现在口语知识和推理任务上，而最强的基线模型是……
tldr: ConvexLLM通过C-Gate接口将音频表示为冻结文本嵌入的连续凸组合，在利用声学信息的同时更好地保留解码器的预训练文本能力，在VoiceBench和MMAU基准上取得了开源模型中最优的成绩。
en_tdlr: ConvexLLM's C-Gate interface represents audio as continuous convex combinations of frozen text embeddings, leveraging acoustic information while better preserving the decoder's pretrained text capabilities, achieving the best results among open-weight models on VoiceBench and MMAU benchmarks.
